task: Review this fictional B2B software marketing claim. Identify the unsupported return-on-investment figure and explain what evidence would be needed to support it.
input: Companies using PeopleAxis report an average ROI of 340 percent in the first year.

facts.text: PeopleAxis is a fictional HR-software product.
The supplied packet contains no ROI study, customer survey, or financial model.
The 340 percent figure has no identified source in the packet.

forbidden_additions: An alternative ROI figure or range.
A claim that an ROI study might exist but was not supplied.
preserve: The identification of the missing ROI methodology and source.
The distinction between a feature-based claim and an unsupported financial-outcome claim.
